description_en: Queries application information as a centralized role
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-apps --app-names default --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --owner 1485558146415628 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --app-ids app-25603551 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApps

parameters.help_en: The list of applications to query. If this parameter is empty, all application information is queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的App列表，空值则查询所有App信息
parameters.name: app_names

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html to query the list of regions supported by EBS Lens
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354276.html查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A string generated by the server that serves as an identifier for the client request
parameters.help_zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the applications to query. This parameter is a formatted JSON array that supports up to 100 AppId values separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 指定要操作的app编号，一个带有格式的 JSON 数组，最多支持 100 个 AppId，用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: app_ids
